description:
**Company Description** 
 SLK Group of Companies is a diversified, fast\-growing enterprise operating across facility management, automotive, infrastructure, manufacturing, renewable energy, and pharmaceuticals. The Group delivers quality\-driven, customized solutions to commercial, residential, and industrial clients, with a strong focus on innovation and trust. Its operations include automotive component manufacturing, premium residential projects, and production of essential goods such as food colors, wall paints, and street lighting systems. SLK Group also invests in clean energy through solar panels and windmills, while providing compliant pharmaceutical products to support healthcare needs. Guided by customer satisfaction, technological advancement, and ethical business practices, the Group continues to expand its footprint as a forward\-looking organization.

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Tendering Specialist role based in Pimpri Chinchwad. The Tendering Specialist will manage the end\-to\-end tender process, including identifying bid opportunities, analyzing tender documents, and coordinating with internal stakeholders to gather technical and commercial inputs. Responsibilities include preparing competitive proposals, ensuring compliance with client and regulatory requirements, and submitting tenders within deadlines. The role involves maintaining tender documentation, tracking bid status, and supporting negotiation and clarification meetings as needed. The Tendering Specialist will also contribute to process improvements, market analysis, and reporting to support strategic decision\-making.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong Tender Management and Procurement skills to handle complete bidding cycles and vendor/client requirements.
* Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills to evaluate tender terms, pricing, risks, and market conditions.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication and Proposal Writing skills to prepare clear submissions and coordinate with cross\-functional teams.
* Candidates should ideally have experience in tendering or contracts within industrial, infrastructure, or manufacturing sectors.
* Relevant qualifications such as a bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Commerce, or a related field are preferred.
* Proficiency in MS Office (especially Excel and Word), attention to detail, and strong organizational skills are beneficial.
* Ability to work under time constraints, follow ethical business practices, and collaborate with diverse stakeholders is expected.

title: Service Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 
 eZpedal is focused on building a robust Light Electric Vehicle (LEV) ecosystem to improve urban mobility and support the transition to renewable energy. The company aims to enhance quality of life in cities by promoting cleaner, more efficient transportation solutions. eZpedal is also developing last mile mobility options that integrate with existing public and private transport systems. These solutions are designed to reduce urban congestion and make daily commutes more convenient and sustainable for communities.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Service Engineer role at eZpedal is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Pimpri Chinchwad. In this role, the Service Engineer will perform diagnostic checks, troubleshoot technical issues, and carry out maintenance and repair tasks on Light Electric Vehicles and related systems. The position involves providing field service support, resolving customer service requests, and documenting service activities and technical findings. The Service Engineer will collaborate with internal teams to report recurring issues, suggest improvements, and support product reliability. The role also includes educating customers on proper use and basic maintenance of equipment to ensure safe and efficient operation.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong Troubleshooting and Technical Support skills for LEV systems and related components.
* Candidates should possess Field Service experience, including on\-site diagnostics and customer support.
* Candidates should possess Maintenance \& Repair skills for electrical, mechanical, and electronic systems.
* Candidates should possess clear and professional Communication skills for interaction with customers and internal teams.
* Diploma or degree in Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Basic understanding of electric vehicle technology, batteries, and power electronics is preferred.
* Ability to work independently in the field, manage multiple service requests, and maintain accurate records.
* Comfort with using diagnostic tools, service software, and standard hand tools; two\-wheeler license is an advantage.
